attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Terrorism, nuclear proliferation, cyber and biological attacks, climate change, and transnational crime cannot be solved by any one nation alone.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Addressing terrorism, nuclear proliferation, cyber and biological attacks, climate change, and transnational crime requires broad and effective global cooperation.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama and the Democratic Party understand that broad and effective global cooperation depends on close collaboration with traditional allies, cultivating partnerships with new centers of influence, and strong U.S. leadership within international institutions.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alliances had been badly damaged under the Bush administration.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Obama and the Democratic Party believe the foundation of global security remains relationships with traditional allies in Europe and Asia, and enduring commitments to their defense.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Obama has worked to methodically strengthen alliances with Europe and Asia.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Obama has pressed allies to bear a greater share of the burden for tackling regional and global challenges.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
